_doc: Deliberate, documented exceptions to the perf gate, accepted by the user on 2026-10-21 ('accept the documented GPU-memory exceptions (and the z^i 30%-opacity Retina zoom at the 14 ms line)'). A FAIL on a listed metric becomes ACCEPTED only while the value stays at or below 'max' (same unit as the metric); above 'max' it still FAILS. Add an entry only with the user's consent and a reason. Second consent (2026-10-21): the hard essential-singularity chains e^{z+1/z} and exp(exp z); example 9 is NOT excepted (to be fixed by inverse support for rational formulas).

phase.default.gpu_live_bytes.reason: U-b (user decision: left = X, right = Y): Phase scenes now also draw the images on the right pane, which the old Phase view left empty. Same footprint as the Image view (2.63 MiB, itself below the reference's Image view); two real leaks were fixed, the rest is the map cache of the visible image.

examples.0.gpu_peak_bytes.reason: as phase.default.gpu_live_bytes (examples load in sequence; the peak carries the previous example's right-pane image)

examples.9.gpu_live_bytes.reason: U-b: this Phase example now also shows its image on the right pane (2.88 MiB)

examples.10.gpu_peak_bytes.reason: U-b: the peak carries the previous Phase example's right-pane image
